name: Maize germ meal, oil < 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture, obtained by extraction of maize germs (Zea maysL.), consisting of spent germs to which parts of the endosperm and outer skins may still adhere. This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. Other name: corn germ meal (USA).

name: Shrimp meal
description: Dried byproduct of the shrimp processing industry, consisting of soft tissues and shells of shrimps and prawns. Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Cottonseed meal, oil 5-20%, crude fibre < 15%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of dehulled cottonseeds (Gossypiumspp.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.

name: Faba bean, white flowers
description: Seed of faba bean (Vicia fabaL.) from low-tannin, white-flowered varieties. Other names: horse bean, field bean.

name: Bakery byproduct
description: Byproduct of bread manufacture, consisting of bread and other bakery products unfit for human consumption.

name: Dicalcium phosphate dihydrate
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound with the formula CaHPO4·2H2O. It is one of the main calcium phosphates used in animal feeding.

name: Camelina oil meal, oil > 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of camelina seeds (Camelina sativaCrantz) using mechanical pressure only.

name: Rice bran, oil > 5%, crude fibre 5-11%
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting in envelopes, germs and fragments of endosperm. This product has not been defatted. Other name: full-fat rice bran.

name: Barley
description: Barley grain (Hordeum vulgareL.). This feed includes two-row and six-row barleys but not hulless ("naked") varieties.

name: Sodium chloride
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula NaCl. Other names : salt, halite.

name: Ferrous sulphate heptahydrate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula FeSO4·7H2O. Other names: iron(II) sulphate heptahydrate, ferrous sulphate heptahydrate.

name: Soybean, whole, toasted, flaked and expanded
description: Soybean seed (Glycine max(L.) Merr.) processed by mild toasting, flaking, expanding and pelleting.

name: Rapeseed meal, oil < 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of rapeseeds (Brassica napusL.,Brassica rapaL. andBrassica junceaL., and their crosses) from varieties having a low content in erucic acid and glucosinolates ("00" in Europe, canola in North America). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. Other names: "00" rapeseed meal, canola meal (for North American rapeseed cultivars).

name: Potato protein concentrate
description: Dried byproduct of starch manufacture from potato tubers (Solanum tuberosumL.) consisting mainly of protein substances obtained after the separation of starch.

name: Phosphate, defluorinated
description: Inorganic chemical compound obtained from natural phosphates (consisting mostly of tricalcium phosphate) defluorinated by calcination.

name: Calcium chloride anhydrous
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CaCl2. It is a colorless crystalline solid at room temperature, highly soluble in water.

name: Cobalt glucoheptonate
description: Chemical compound that is a salt of colbalt used for cobalt supplementation.

name: Calcium iodate hexahydrate
description: Hydrated inorganic compound composed of calcium and iodate anion, with the formula Ca(IO3)2·6H2O.

name: Copper carbonate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula Cu2CO3(OH)2. Other names: copper carbonate, copper(II) carbonate hydroxide.

name: Monosodium phosphate anhydrous
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula NaH2PO4.
